bio.text: Ryan Michael Kelly is an independent candidate for New Jersey's 3rd Congressional District, according to WHYY.
Kelly, 43, is an educator and a former federal civil servant who spent 13 years with the Department of Homeland Security in government operations and program administration.
He was previously a member of the Lake Como Borough Council in Monmouth County.
The New Jersey Globe lists his ballot designation as "Affordability, Accountability, People".

sources.title: New Jersey election 2026: What to know about the 3rd Congressional District race
Husband-and-wife duo from Tennessee will run as pro-life independents for competitive N.J. seats
